description:
Use when the user needs the complete picture of one tender: all fields of vergabe_bekanntmachung plus the AI-structured sections (description, criteria, …), a Q&A list (e.g. 'Is a security clearance required?'), topic facets, and a list of available procurement documents (filenames, sizes, MIME types, download status). Field guide: `assistant_ready` = true means the procurement documents are downloaded and analysed, so `sections` (AI-structured summary), `qa` and `eligibility_summary` are filled; when false these stay empty and the notice fields and summaries are what is available. `documents[].download_status`: ok = file stored at Overfit, pending = not fetched yet, failed/skipped = could not be fetched. The files themselves are not returned: your user downloads them via the notice's portal link (`procedure_room_url` or `detail_url`). Input is the numeric notice_id, NOT the string uid ('source:id') that vergabe_bekanntmachung takes: every Vergabe result carries both, read 'notice_id' from vergabe_suche or vergabe_bekanntmachung results, or 'id' from vergabe_liste results. Rate-limited at 30 requests/10 min and 200/day per IP (same bucket as notice detail).

Example user questions: "Welche Unterlagen gibt es für diese Ausschreibung?"; "Gibt es eine strukturierte Zusammenfassung der Vergabeunterlagen?"; "Welche Fragen und Antworten sind zu dieser Ausschreibung bekannt?"

notice_id.description: Numeric notice ID (not the string uid): field 'notice_id' in vergabe_suche / vergabe_bekanntmachung results, field 'id' in vergabe_liste results.
